description: This Java class serves as a REST controller managing banking account operations, including retrieving account details, adding new accounts, transferring funds, and fetching transaction history. It utilizes Spring Boot annotations for REST endpoints and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: REST controller that handles HTTP requests related to account management and transactions in the banking application.

methods.name: getByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve account details by account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new account for an existing customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Handles PUT request to transfer funds between accounts.

methods.name: getTransactionByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch all transactions associated with an account number.
